entries.text: Right-click in the editor to use formatting, paragraph and list styles, links, clipboard actions, and eligible Skills. Choosing a Skill prepares it in the Assistant with your selected text; hold Ctrl to send it immediately.
Ctrl could be lost when choosing a Skill from the editor menu, preventing immediate sending. The modifier now works through the action.
Article rows show when Assistant requests are running or failed, responses are unread, or proposals, translations, and findings need review.
When an Article changes after a suggestion is created, you can view the earlier suggestion read-only, continue writing, or request an updated suggestion for the current Article.
Dismissing an earlier suggestion could leave its review open. It now returns you to writing without changing the Article.
Choose whether interface animations play in General settings. Turning them off disables dimming, animations, and transitions while respecting your device reduced-motion preference.
Update information identifies stable security releases and warns when an update may have compatibility implications.
Revision character counts now count Unicode characters correctly, including emoji.
